items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: he said he had to keep one of the boys, had to keep Couchy Roberts on the alto... I don't know why.

ctx.x: Yeah. She wanted me to play with her out there. She was just playing the piano by herself and singing. So I played out there a while, then Basie arrived in town and he sent for me. And I went on and followed them around up to Cleveland, got up there in Cleveland and rehearsing(?) went on. I don't know what happened, but anyway, I got over to Scranton, Pennsylvania, and he said he had to keep one of the boys, had to keep Couchy Roberts on the alto... I don't know why. I guess
